data.content:
JOIN US! GREEN VIBES FKM 2026 🌱

LEARN. ACT. INSPIRE.
Engineering for a Sustainable Tomorrow
📅 1 October – 31 December 2026
🎯 14 exciting green activities
🌿 LAUNCH DAY – 1 OCTOBER 2026
🕣 8:30 AM – 1:00 PM
📍 Seminar Hall & Lestari Room C23, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering (FKM), UTM
✨ 8.30 AM Opening Ceremony
♻️ 10.00 AM Trash-to-Cash – Sort, Recycle & Earn KITARecycle points for Metals, Paper, Plastics 
🛢️ Oil-to-Money – Collect, Recycle & Earn RM3/kg. Every drop have value.
🌱 Green Bloom – Plant, Name & Grow
…and 10 more activities throughout the programme! 🌍💚
👥 OPEN TO ALL!
FKM Students • FKM Staff • UTM Students • UTM Staff
CPD for FKM/UTM Staff
Come join us, have fun, and take action for a greener FKM! 🌱
💚 LEARN. ACT. INSPIRE.
